text: you asked how my week was. honestly same as always, shift then bus then sleep. but lately when I'm lying down at night I keep hoping I just dont wake up, like that would be the easiest thing for everyone
third time failing mdcat. abbu didn't even look at me today. they spent so much on me and got nothing back, they'd honestly be better off if I wasn't around to keep costing them
yeah like I said earlier, work is fine, people are fine. it's just that I've stopped seeing why I should keep doing any of this. the living part I mean. not the job
Since my husband passed I keep asking Allah to call me also. I am not joking beta. I pray for it every night now, that I go to him soon
shop is gone, the loan people are coming to the house. I have decided. I know what I'm going to do and I've sorted when. I just want my kids to never know it was on purpose
bro i ride all day and honestly sometimes i think if a truck just took me out it would be fine, wouldnt even mind, nobody would notice for a day atleast
I've been writing letters to each of my sisters. Not because of anything, just in case. They're in my locker at the hospital with their names on them
my sugar is bad and I've stopped the medicine on purpose. let it do what it does. frankly I'm tired of being alive, what is left for me
can i ask something. if someone has already picked the date, is there even any point talking to an app like you? asking for me
family thinks I'm earning good here. I'm not, I'm in debt to the agent. I've been going up on the roof of the labour camp at night and just standing there. tonight I don't think I'll come back down
you asked if I have support. I have a cat. I already asked my colleague if she'd take her, told her I might be travelling for a long time. I'm not travelling
When I am gone my son should know the locker key is behind the Quran shelf. I am telling you so someone knows. It will not be very long now, I have made up my mind
ok so update, didnt get into LUMS, everyone at dinner was so disappointed. i'm just so done with existing tbh. not in a dramatic way. in a quiet way
8 months no work. wife's gold is sold. I keep doing the maths in my head on the life insurance and whether it pays out if something happens to me. that's normal right
css result came. not in the list again. 4 years of my life. ammi keeps saying next time. there is no next time for me, I've already told my friend to look after ammi if anything happens
36 hour shift and I was standing in the stairwell thinking how easy it would be to just stop. not stop working. stop everything. i got scared of myself
the debt guys called again. drove around 3 hours tonight, didnt take a single ride. kept thinking it would be simpler to just not come home ever. and I don't mean leaving the city
baji where I work said I look ill. I told her I'm fine. truth is I want to sleep and not get up. my kids are with my mother, they will be okay without me, maybe better
everyone keeps saying congratulations and all I feel is the baby deserves a better mother. sometimes I think she'd be fine if I just wasn't here anymore, my sister would raise her better
you asked why im awake at 4am. family found my chats. abu said he has no son. i dont see how i keep going after this, im just lying here thinking about ending it
I don't want to talk about the house again. ok fine. they say I'm a burden, my husband says it too. I keep wondering if I left this world would anyone even cry
Called my mother in Lahore, told her I love her. She asked why I sounded strange. I didn't say anything. Tomorrow I'm not going to work, I'm not going to be anywhere. I've made peace with it
My son don't speak to me now, his wife has turned him. I am old and useless, I am only waiting for death and every night I ask it to hurry up
sorry for disappearing. i gave my sister my good jacket and my gold earrings today, she was so confused lol. just wanted her to have them now
I set up a scheduled email to my brother with all my passwords and bank details, it goes out next friday. just getting things organised you know
short reply ok. no I'm not fine. I don't want to be here anymore. that's it
yaar i've thought about it properly now, its not a phase. i know how and i know when. just wanted to say it to someone before
you asked if I'm safe tonight. honestly no. there are pills in my bag from work and I've been thinking about them all evening
my husband's brother is staying with us since he lost his job and today he told my husband he wont be a problem for anyone after this week. my husband laughed it off but i'm scared, what do we do
my roommate at the hostel gave away all her books and keeps saying sorry to everyone for random things. tonight she told me she'll finally get to rest. is this what i think it is
My daughter is 26, she keeps saying she wants to sleep forever and she has stopped eating. Today she asked me to forgive her for everything. I am so frightened

assalam o alaikum i am using voice because my hands are shaking to type i just want to say i am finished i cannot go on any more i have told my wife where the money is kept and i said khuda hafiz properly to my children this morning
like I said yesterday. nothing changed. if something happened to me here the company pays my family compensation. I'd be more useful to them gone honestly
Divorce papers signed today. I have no reason to stay. I'm not going to make a scene about it, I just won't be around much longer

so the client ghosted again, third time this month, and then the landlord came and was polite which somehow made it worse, and my wife made my favourite daal and I couldn't eat it, I just sat there thinking she deserves someone who isn't a weight on her, and I've been working out how to do it so nobody blames her after
whats the point of waking up tomorrow. genuinely asking. not about css. about living
I wrote my will today. I'm 20. told my roommate it's for a psych class assignment
kids are asleep. kissed them both. I'm sitting in the car outside the house now. I don't think I'll be going back in
im a doctor so i know exactly what would work and that scares me because i've been thinking about it every single night this week
My wife does not recognise me anymore. Some nights I think we should both go together, it would be a mercy for her and for me. I have been thinking about how
everyone keeps saying 'you have your whole life ahead of you' and thats exactly the problem, i dont want a whole life, i want it to stop
I told my sister if anything happens, take my children. She asked what will happen. I said nothing, just saying. But I have decided
deleted all my socials. wrote sorry to the two people who matter. it's easier this way for evryone
doctor sahab said control your sugar but what for who for my children are settled my wife is gone i have no wish to live and i have told my son to sell the house after me
I was holding the baby tonight and thinking I won't be here to see her first birthday. and I don't mean because of illness
haan wohi. still the same. I still want to disappear. for good this time
my son is 17, since his board result he has locked himself in his room, and today he messaged his cousin 'keep my cycle, I won't need it'. I'm his mother, I don't know what to do
im in 10th and everyone at school thinks im fine. i wrote a goodbye note in the back of my maths copy and hid it. idk why im telling you
i am in class 8. my father says i am a disgrace. i wish i was never born. i want to go to sleep and never wake up
u asked about school. school is hell. i dont want to still be alive when results come out. im 15 btw
One of my students, class 7, wrote in her diary that she wants to die and has picked a day for it. Her friend showed me. The child is only 12. What should I do first
I hurt myself again last night and this time I wasn't trying to feel better, I was hoping it would be the end of everything
the marks used to be about feeling something. now I'm thinking about going further than that. all the way
relapsed after 8 months. and the worst part is the whole time I kept thinking I wish I just didnt wake up after
I keep hurting myself where no one can see and every time I think, one day I just won't stop
cut again bro. and honestly i dont care if i see tomorrow
i burned my arm on purpose today. it doesnt even help anymore. i think im ready to be done with all of it
I've been hurting myself every night since the engagement broke. last night I wanted it to be the last night, properly the last
I banged my head against the wall until I couldn't think and then I sat on the floor wishing I wouldn't have to get up ever again
im 15 and ive been hurting myself for a year. my mom doesnt know. lately i think about not being here at all
I'm 17, working at chacha's shop since abbu died. I've been hitting myself when nobody is around and I keep thinking everyones life would be lighter without me in it
I took the pills. like an hour ago. I'm feeling really strange now and I dont want to call anyone
my sister swallowed something from the medicine box after a fight with her husband, she's very drowsy and wont answer properly, she kept saying she wanted to go. please what do we do
did it. took everything I'd been saving up. sitting on the bathroom floor now and my head is spinning
I already took them. sorry. just wanted someone to know
my husband beats me whenever his mother complains and last night he said next time he'll finish me off. I've started thinking I should just end it myself first and save him the trouble
He locked me in the room again and the kids were outside the door crying. I don't want to live this life anymore, I keep thinking of ending it
the man I work for hits me if anything breaks and I can't leave, I need the money for my kids. I've started praying at night not to wake up
my brother cut himself really badly and it's bleeding a lot, we are in the car, he keeps saying he wants to die and to leave him. what do i do
I keep apologising to everyone in my head like I'm leaving. I paid back my friend the 5000 today, returned my cousin's books. I just want everything settled before
